title: Transform a Plane (and a Line) Between Frames
hints: A point x_A on the plane satisfies n_Aᵀ x_A + d_A = 0. Substitute x_A = Rᵀ(x_B − t) and read off the plane in B.
n_B = R n_A (a normal is a direction, so translation doesn't affect it). Then d_B = d_A − n_Bᵀ t.
Compactly: π_B = T_BA⁻ᵀ π_A, with π = (n, d) as a homogeneous 4-vector.
Line (point p, direction u): p' = T p (a point), u' = R u (a direction).
